title: fix(core): report truncated model streams as errors instead of complete
why: Changes how core agent-controller reports finished vs truncated model streams; affects every run's completion status.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@mastra/core': patch
+---
+
+Agent runs whose model stream stops without a finish reason now end with an error instead of being reported as complete.
